title: Getting started
summary: Choose a project mode, register a folder, and understand which tools are optional.
body:
CyRevision keeps Git, synchronization, backups, and VPN independent. Choose only the modules required by the project.

CREATE A REPOSITORY
Use Create repository for a new Git project, or Open repository for an existing one. Add folder registers a folder for Sync or Backup without requiring Git.

PROJECT MODES
• Git: local revision control only.
• Git + Sync: local Git plus signed peer exchange.
• Sync: current files synchronized without Git.
• Sync + Versions: file synchronization with Syncthing versioning.
• Backup: deduplicated snapshots without continuous synchronization.

REQUIREMENTS
Git and Git LFS are required for Git projects. Syncthing is needed only for a Sync mode. WireGuard is needed only for VPN. CyRevision never starts an optional tool merely because a project was opened.

title: Everyday Git workflow
summary: Review changes, create commits, work with branches, and inspect history without leaving CyRevision.
body:
REFRESH AND REVIEW
Refresh reads the repository status. Select a changed file to inspect its diff before staging it. Binary and LFS files are identified explicitly.

CREATE A REVISION
1. Review the changed files.
2. Stage all changes or use the repository tools for a narrower selection.
3. Enter a clear commit message.
4. Create the revision.

BRANCHES AND REMOTES
Create or switch local branches from the Branches panel. Fetch downloads remote references without modifying the working tree. Pull integrates the configured remote branch. Push publishes local commits to the standard remote.

HISTORY EXPLORER
Search commits by message, author, or hash. Select two revisions for an A ↔ B comparison. Exporting a historical file writes a separate copy and never changes the working tree.

title: LFS Time Machine
summary: Inspect, request, export, and restore large-file versions without silently downloading history.
body:
TRACK LARGE ASSETS
Add patterns such as *.uasset, *.umap, *.png, or *.fbx to Git LFS before committing large binary assets.

STORAGE STATES
• Local: the object can be previewed, exported, or restored immediately.
• Peer: an authorized device announced the object in a signed inventory.
• Archive: the object was detected in the configured cold archive.
• Missing: no verified location is currently known.

ON-DEMAND REQUESTS
Select a missing historical version and choose Request from peer. The signed request expires after seven days. An authorized peer publishes the object during a later exchange. Interrupted copies resume from a verified partial file and are accepted only after SHA-256 validation.

RESTORE SAFETY
Restore changes only the working file. It does not stage, commit, push, or lock the asset automatically.

title: Smart Sync and authorized peers
summary: Run an isolated Syncthing instance and exchange signed Git/LFS data with approved devices.
body:
ISOLATED SYNCTHING
Each CyRevision project uses its own configuration, database, API key, loopback address, and port. CyRevision never searches for, reconfigures, pauses, or stops a personal Syncthing instance.

START AND STOP
Selecting a Syncthing executable does not start it. Start launches the dedicated project instance. Pause, Resume, and Stop affect only the exact child process created by CyRevision.

PEER ADMISSION
Create a single-use invitation and send its verification code through a separate channel. Approve the returned join request only after checking the device and role. Revocation removes future Git/LFS authorization.

SMART LFS POLICY
Current objects are always prioritized. Historical objects can remain on demand, include a configurable number of recent versions, or replicate everything. Signed inventories advertise availability without forcing a download.

title: Backups, retention, and cold archive
summary: Create deduplicated snapshots and copy older content to cheaper mounted storage.
body:
SNAPSHOTS
Choose a backup location and create a snapshot. Files are addressed by SHA-256, so identical content is stored only once. Unreal caches and build outputs are excluded by default.

RETENTION
Configure a timeline, maximum version count, maximum age, or storage budget. Retention applies to the active backup store after a snapshot succeeds.

RESTORE
Restore into an empty destination whenever possible. CyRevision refuses to overwrite existing files unless an operation explicitly permits it.

COLD ARCHIVE
Select a secondary disk, NAS folder, or mounted object storage and choose an archive age. Eligible manifests and missing objects are copied while at least the newest snapshots remain active. Cold archiving is non-destructive and never deletes the active copy automatically.

title: WireGuard, services, and Unreal Swarm
summary: Create an optional VPN that remains independent from Git and Sync permissions.
body:
INDEPENDENT MODULE
VPN can run alone or alongside Git and Sync. Joining a VPN never grants repository or synchronized-folder access automatically.

BACKEND CHOICE
System installation uses WireGuard already installed on the machine. Integrated runtime uses official platform components bundled under VpnRuntime and validates every required file against runtime.json SHA-256 hashes. The choice belongs to the project and can only change while its CyRevision tunnel is stopped.

GUIDED COMPUTER SETUP
Client-only peers need no inbound firewall or router change. An incoming host opens only its configured WireGuard UDP port. Optional Swarm TCP 8008-8009 and CyRevision control TCP 47831 rules are restricted to the VPN subnet. Diagnose detects the LAN address, gateway and firewall. Windows Defender, UFW and firewalld plans can be applied after explicit administrator confirmation; macOS follows the official application-firewall screen. CyRevision rules use deterministic per-project names and can be removed without touching unrelated rules.

ROUTER / MODEM
Reserve the detected LAN address, then forward one external WireGuard UDP port to the same local port. Never forward Swarm or control ports. Test from another network. A private or 100.64.0.0/10 WAN address may indicate CGNAT and require a public server or a public IP from the provider. CyRevision never enables UPnP automatically.

SYNC-ASSISTED ONBOARDING
The current signed invitation or response can be placed in the dedicated Sync exchange. Only signed public VPN payloads are accepted; SHA-256 and signed metadata are checked, secret-shaped fields are rejected, and private keys remain local. Loading a message never joins or accepts it automatically.

UNREAL SWARM
Use stable VPN addresses for the Swarm coordinator and agents. Windows Swarm commonly uses TCP 8008 and 8009; the assistant keeps these ports inside the VPN.

title: Unreal plugin and advisory reservations
summary: Open CyRevision from Unreal and show who is working on an asset without blocking anyone.
body:
PLUGIN INSTALLATION
Copy plugins/CyRevisionUnreal into the Unreal project's Plugins folder, apply the example editor settings, regenerate project files, and compile the Editor target.

OPEN IN CYREVISION
The Tools menu opens the external CyRevision client for the current Unreal project. Git, LFS, Sync, backups, and most comparisons continue to work with Unreal closed.

ADVISORY RESERVATIONS
From the Content Browser, choose Report: I am working on this asset. The marker shares the user, machine, and update time. It is informational only: no checkout, permission change, or Git LFS lock is created. Multiple users may continue after seeing a warning.

EXPIRATION
The plugin renews active markers periodically. Stale markers expire automatically after the configured duration and can be cleaned from the Work in progress tab.

title: Discord project agent
summary: Publish grouped Git updates to one Discord channel without requiring GitHub.
body:
CHANNEL WEBHOOK
Create an incoming webhook in the Discord channel that should receive notifications, then paste its URL in the Discord agent tab. A webhook belongs to a specific channel, so CyRevision does not need a global bot token.

EXECUTION MODES
Integrated runs inside the desktop application. Autonomous runs as a multi-project sidecar and continues when the desktop closes. Launch local agent starts the packaged sidecar; a remote server or VPN peer can run the same executable. The control API is Bearer-authenticated, uses loopback by default, requires HTTPS remotely, and allows private HTTP only after explicit trusted-WireGuard approval.

SAFE BASELINE
The first start records the current HEAD and does not publish old history. Later checks group new commits into one message and can also report active-branch changes. Pulls, peer exchanges, and local commits are detected once they become visible in the local Git repository.

DUPLICATE PREVENTION
CyRevision stores a per-project checkpoint only after Discord accepts a message. Run automatic monitoring on a single agent per project; two active agents have independent local checkpoints and may both report the same update.

SECRETS AND MENTIONS
The webhook and autonomous control token remain in local user configuration, outside the project and repository. The API never returns the saved webhook. Automatic messages disable Discord mentions.

LIMITS
The agent reports Git history visible locally and works without GitHub. Pull requests, issues, and review events belong to a forge and require that forge's own Discord integration.

title: Stable release updates
summary: Check, download, verify, and launch a published CyRevision installer from the Help tab.
body:
RELEASES ONLY
The updater reads the latest stable GitHub Release for CyRevision. Commits, branches, drafts, and prereleases are never offered as application updates. Project repositories remain independent and do not require GitHub.

CHECK FOR UPDATES
CyRevision checks after startup, and Check for updates can be used at any time. The installed assembly version is compared with the published release tag.

PLATFORM PACKAGE
CyRevision selects the native installer for the current system: Windows Setup, Linux DEB for x64 or ARM64, or macOS DMG for x64 or ARM64. The release page remains available when a compatible package is not present.

DOWNLOAD SAFETY
The package is downloaded into the CyRevision cache. Its SHA-256 value must match the release's SHA256SUMS.txt manifest before the operating system is asked to open it. Installation never begins silently and no source-code git pull is performed.

title: Troubleshooting and safety
summary: Diagnose missing tools, failed exchanges, partial transfers, and common repository problems.
body:
TOOLS NOT DETECTED
Confirm that git --version and git lfs version work in a terminal. Restart CyRevision after changing PATH. Syncthing and WireGuard remain optional until their modules are enabled.

PUSH REJECTED
Fetch first and inspect the incoming branch. Never use a force push unless replacing remote history is deliberate and understood.

PAIR EXCHANGE NOT MOVING
Check that the dedicated Sync instance is running, the peer is connected, and its membership certificate still has a Git-writing role. A file appearing in the exchange folder is not imported unless an authorized signed inventory announces it.

PARTIAL LFS FILES
Files ending in .cyrevision-partial are resumable local staging files. Do not rename them into the LFS object store manually. The next exchange verifies the existing prefix and completes or safely restarts the copy.

SAFE RECOVERY
Keep the working tree, active .git directory, backup store, and cold archive as separate locations. Before deleting any data, create a snapshot and verify a restore into a different folder.
